# ── OPEN-SOURCE PRODUCTION TOOLKIT (NPM) ─────────────────
1. env-schema-guard
   Zero-dependency startup configuration and schema validator for TypeScript & Node.js (< 2.5 KB).
   Prevents silent boot crashes in Kubernetes/Docker pods, aggregates error reports, and provides automatic type coercion.
   NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/env-schema-guard
   GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/env-schema-guard
   Article: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/env-schema-guard-zero-dependency-config-validator

2. retry-circuit
   Ultra-lightweight async resilience engine combining exponential backoff, AWS-standard full randomized jitter,
   per-attempt timeouts, and a 3-state Circuit Breaker pattern (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF-OPEN) in ~1.5 KB.
   Protects distributed microservices and payment gateways from the thundering herd problem and cascading downtime.
   NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/retry-circuit
   GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/retry-circuit
   Article: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/retry-circuit-distributed-resilience-engine

3. prompt-kit-js
   Production-ready, versioned prompt registry and heuristic token estimator for Generative AI applications (< 2 KB).
   Enforces strict variable safety with MissingVariableError, enables semantic prompt versioning (1.0.0, 2.0.0),
   and works provider-agnostically with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Groq, and local models.
   NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/prompt-kit-js
   GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/prompt-kit
   Article: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/prompt-kit-js-versioned-llm-prompt-registry
